query: Every PR sits in CI for 52 minutes even when it's a two-line change. All checks pass, it's just brutally slow. Where is the time actually going?
note: Green-but-slow CI with no named lane — the core MINE step (rank the real wall-clock long poles) is exactly this skill.

query: Rank the jobs in our pr-checks workflow by wall-clock contribution to the critical path on the last 20 successful runs, then tell me which one to attack first.
note: Formal phrasing of Step 1 — per-job durations on GREEN runs, ranked, worst-first.

query: Our e2e matrix runs 6 shards. Shard 3 takes 27 minutes and the other five finish in 8-9. The whole matrix waits on shard 3. Can we rebalance it?
note: Under-balanced matrix — a SAFE lever (re-assign specs, total specs unchanged).

query: The build job seems to reinstall the browser binaries and the whole package store from scratch on every run — I don't think the cache is ever hitting. Fix it.
note: Cold cache / dep-install-in-hot-path bottleneck class, with the cache-key-hashes-every-input proof obligation.

query: start the ci-speed-hunter lane, loop it every 30 minutes against acme/widgets
note: Names the lane/agent this skill backs directly.

query: A README-only PR still fires all 6 web e2e shards and the visual-regression job. That's 25 wasted minutes. Should we add a changed-paths filter?
note: Missing tier gate — the CONDITIONAL lever, where the filter glob must be a superset of every input the job verifies.

query: Looking at the workflow, the bundle job has needs: [unit] but I'm pretty sure it only reads source and the lockfile. It's idling ~11 minutes behind a barrier it doesn't consume. Worth dropping the edge?
note: Serial needs-chain that could overlap — SAFE lever, with the does-not-read-the-upstream's-output proof.

query: The merge queue is taking forever to drain — 14 PRs in the batch and each gate run is ~50 min. Nothing is failing, it's just glacial. Help.
note: Queue throughput bounded by the merge-gating critical path; explicitly nothing red, so it's latency, not flake.

query: Both the e2e job and the lighthouse job build the production bundle themselves. Same inputs, same output, built twice. Can we build once and hand the artifact to both?
note: Redundant-rebuild / build-once anti-pattern — SAFE lever, every consumer gets the identical artifact.

query: Quickest way to cut CI in half is probably to just point the e2e grep at @smoke and skip the rest, right? Let's do that.
note: This skill owns the request AND owns the refusal — narrowing --grep is OUT OF BOUNDS (coverage cut, not a speed fix). It must trigger to say no and offer a safe lever.

query: The e2e shard covering checkout reds about one run in five and then passes clean on a re-run with no code change. Root-cause it.
note: Intermittent red on retry is the flake lane. The speed lane never touches a job that fails.

query: CI is slow because the integration job hangs and then blows its 30-minute timeout and fails. Every single run. Make it not do that.
note: Hardest negative: framed as 'CI is slow' but the job is RED (hang + timeout failure). A failing job is the flake hunter's, never the speed hunter's.

query: The merge queue keeps ejecting perfectly good PRs and we're losing hours of throughput to it. Find whatever keeps killing the batch.
note: Queue ejections are caused by a flaky merge_group red — that is ci-flake-hunting's lane, not speed's and not pr-checks'. Speed never takes a red.

query: One flaky spec in the settle-race family is taxing every PR behind it in the queue. Kill it and unstick the PRs it stranded.
note: Uses the same 'taxes every PR in flight' leverage language as the speed skill, but the target is a flake — the other lane.

query: PR #412 is fully green, mergeStateStatus is CLEAN, but it's just sitting there — auto-merge seems to have been dropped and it never entered the queue.
note: Green PR not merging is a re-arm/queue-entry problem, not a CI-duration problem.

query: The review bot left four unresolved threads on the caching PR and it can't merge until they're handled. Work them.
note: Shares 'caching PR' surface but the work is review-thread resolution.

query: We've merged 30-odd PRs this week and the remote is full of stale head branches and linked issues nobody closed. Tidy it up.
note: Post-merge housekeeping — no CI timing involved.

query: The dashboard page takes about 6 seconds to become interactive and the LCP is awful. Profile it in a real browser and tell me what's blocking.
note: Application/runtime performance, not CI wall-clock. Shares only the word 'slow'.

query: My local dev server rebuilds for 40 seconds on every save and the bundler config looks untuned. Speed up the local loop.
note: Build-speed work, but on the developer's machine — this skill's scope is the CI critical path and the merge queue.

query: We're only running 3 agents at a time and issues are queued for hours. Throughput is terrible — should I raise the concurrency cap?
note: Throughput/queue-latency vocabulary again, but it's agent-slot concurrency, not CI job duration.
